Node.js is part of 37 of my public repositories, from 2013 to 2026.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (17), [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (6), [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (4) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (4).

Most recently: [korczis.github.io](@/work/korczis-github-io.md): Tomas Korcak (korczis): software that proves its work. Projects, live sites and the stack behind them. Zola + Flowbite Pro on GitHub Pages, supervised by Majordomus; [Majordomus reel](@/work/majordomus-reel.md): Voice, frames, music and sound, all generated and versioned like software; [vomaste.cz](@/work/vomaste-cz.md).

2 of these projects run as live sites.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Node.js: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Node.js to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
